summary: In "Massive Update for Home Depot Stock Investors," published 2026-10-03, Parkevtate Vosianc CFA upgrades Home Depot to a buying opportunity for the first time in about two years — a notable reversal, since he says he warned against buying HD for the last 1.5–2 years and that proved prudent as the stock fell roughly 30% in a year. Price context: $286 market vs his $263 DCF intrinsic value, and a forward P/E of 17.85, the cheapest in years. Thesis: top-tier management that has navigated 7 tough years, now fairly to slightly undervalued on multiple metrics — he'd buy at a fair price and dollar-cost average as macro improves, though likely 3–6 months of headwinds come first. Fundamentals: ROIC 18.5% (about 2x WACC), margins 12.4%. Bull: consumer rebounds on low unemployment plus the AI capex boom. Bear: near-term oil and disposable-income pressure on home improvement. Call: HD — BUY, first tracked call on record. No other tickers discussed.
